'''N4-S4''' was a [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] during the [[Galactic War]]. Stationed on the [[Vaiken Spacedock]], N4-S4 asked an [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] to rendezvous with [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Altiss]] regarding the situation on [[Denova]].<ref name="Defection on Denova" />
